run_self_play_training: run a self-play PPO training experiment on a MeltingPot substrate using RLlib
create_ppo_config: create a PPO configuration for multi-agent self-play on a MeltingPot substrate with LSTM and convolutional layers
train_model: train a multi-agent RL model using RLlib PPO with configurable iteration count
configure_multi_agent_policies: configure multi-agent policies with one policy per player role and a policy mapping function
setup_model_architecture: setup a convolutional neural network model with LSTM for multi-agent RL training
